Root_CAS_contract: External Root only; expected_sha=fresh parent,force=false,actualreadback candidate; exact manifest/sources/facts and fullnewbody/fullscope preserved flags. Executor has no reference or PR writer.
Root_model_acceptance_required: ACTUAL_ROOT_RECEIPT; exact source/manifest/fact bindings; scientific/priority/custody/publication/tracker acceptance; two distinct fresh whole-package receipt paths; two distinct Root-accepted native source/exact-manifest audits; exact already-merged PR identities; finite public selection reviewed; no new publish/tracker action.
candidate_lock_contract: Acquire the original manifest-pinned WriterLock before candidate state/construction; hold through independent candidate verification. Every effect_guard checks the original inode/payload/held process at entry and immediately before its immutable POST call, in addition to all inherited fresh source/Root/local/PR/Main guards.
canonical_API_host: Every gh API argv explicitly supplies --hostname github.com; GH_HOST cannot select another provider.

field_contracts.candidate_journal: One exact fresh journal basename bound by manifest and external Root gate, no redispatch/retry after uncertainty.
field_contracts.commit: One parent=[fresh MAIN], deterministic fixed author/committer/UTCseconds and newline-terminated canonical message; exact metadata or precisely one omitted terminalLF only.
field_contracts.files: 6..600 exact rows(path,source,bytes,sha256,git_blob,preimage); sources sealed0444, body<=4000000, selected total<=8000000; native tuple preimage separate from local preimages. Non-view archive/late paths absent or byte-exact no-op only.
field_contracts.local_views: Exactly5 path/preimage/source rows. Local preimages may differ from native preimages; both log prefixes independently required. Mixed pre/post local states permitted only by locked resume after actualCAS.
field_contracts.protected_queue: Fresh regular wholeQUEUE tuple(mode,type,sha), never selected/changed.
field_contracts.public_allowlist: Sorted distinct finite positive list exactly matching selected A210 public artifacts; no folder-wide selection. All Root-selected contents bound by exact row pin/native oid and external Root acceptance.

log_policy: One unique canonical terminal PR210_NATIVE_PHASE_FACTS marker. Preserve every exact local and native append-log prefix including all priorPR209 historical markers. No stale/malformed/duplicate PR210 markers.
